scripts.build: pnpm generate:openapi && pnpm exec nx run-many -t build --projects=http-client,identity-client,identity-sdk,identity-sdk-web,web-runtime,web-ui,email-templates,drive-web,identity-web && pnpm exec nx run rust-workspace:build
scripts.build:web: pnpm --dir apps/drive-web build && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web build
scripts.build:analyze: ANALYZE=true pnpm --dir apps/drive-web build && ANALYZE=true pnpm --dir apps/identity-web build
scripts.check:size: tsx scripts/check-bundle-size.ts apps/drive-web/dist && tsx scripts/check-bundle-size.ts apps/identity-web/dist
scripts.check: pnpm check:structure && pnpm check:nx-boundaries && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:api
scripts.check:web: pnpm exec nx run-many -t format:check --projects=drive-web,identity-web,http-client,identity-client,identity-sdk,identity-sdk-web,web-runtime,web-ui,email-templates && pnpm exec nx run-many -t lint --projects=drive-web,identity-web,http-client,identity-client,identity-sdk,identity-sdk-web,web-runtime,web-ui,email-templates && pnpm exec nx run-many -t typecheck --projects=drive-web,identity-web,http-client,identity-client,identity-sdk,identity-sdk-web,web-runtime,web-ui,email-templates && vp check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml vite.config.ts tsconfig.base.json nx.json
scripts.format: pnpm --dir apps/drive-web format && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web format && vp fmt --write libs/ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml vite.config.ts && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: pnpm exec nx run-many -t format:check --projects=drive-web,identity-web,http-client,identity-client,identity-sdk,identity-sdk-web,web-runtime,web-ui,email-templates && vp fmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml vite.config.ts tsconfig.base.json nx.json && cargo fmt --all --check
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:web && pnpm exec nx run rust-workspace:lint
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:structure && pnpm check:nx-boundaries && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test
